CHEBI:1387.name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylethyleneglycol
CHEBI:1387.description: A tetrol composed of ethyleneglycol having a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at the 1-position.

CHEBI:1784.name: biphenyl-4-amine
CHEBI:1784.description: An aminobiphenyl that is biphenyl substituted by an amino group at position 4.

CHEBI:1895.name: 4-methylbenzyl alcohol
CHEBI:1895.description: A methylbenzyl alcohol in which the methyl substituent is para to the hydroxymethyl group.

CHEBI:1941.name: 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoic acid
CHEBI:1941.description: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the  conjugate acid of 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate.

CHEBI:27407.name: kinetin
CHEBI:27407.description: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is  adenine carrying a (furan-2-ylmethyl) substituent at the exocyclic amino group.

CHEBI:38161.name: chelator
CHEBI:38161.description: A ligand with two or more separate binding sites that can bind to a single metallic central atom, forming a chelate.

CHEBI:88.name: (S)-(-)-citronellol
CHEBI:88.description: A citronellol that is oct-6-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 7 (the 3S-enantiomer).
